QFU.Title: Quick File Upload
QFU.ConfigurationTitle: Quick File Upload — Regex groups and rules
QFU.HelpHint: Description and help for Quick File Upload. See also
QFU.SettingsHint: Manage regex groups and rules. Scene controls, appearance and upload actions have separate menus.
QFU.GroupsHint: Order groups and rules with the arrows. Regex is checked before size. See Settings help for routing and fallback details.
QFU.LayoutHint: Enter pixels (720) or percentages (75%). Window percentages use the viewport; pad and header percentages use the application. Blank pad name uses the translated default.
QFU.ImportStaged: Import loaded into the editor. Review and Save to apply, or Cancel to discard.
QFU.GmOnly: Only a GM can change upload configuration.
QFU.SettingsSaved: Settings saved. Reopen the upload window to apply its initial dimensions.
QFU.DropHint: Drop files, click the cloud to browse, or click this text and press Ctrl+V
QFU.WaitBatch: Wait for the current batch to finish.
QFU.NoPermission: You do not have permission to upload files.
QFU.LocalFilesOnly: Drop local files; folders and links are not supported.
QFU.InvalidSize: Sizes must be positive numbers (pixels) or percentages, such as 720 or 75%.
QFU.InvalidPath: Use a relative user-data folder, such as uploads/images; absolute paths and traversal are not allowed.
QFU.InvalidSettings: Settings must be a configuration object containing a Groups array.
QFU.InvalidAppearance: Check the pad name, hex color, button placement, and parent control ID.
QFU.InvalidOrder: Button position must be -1 (last) or a non-negative integer.
QFU.InvalidGroups: Groups and their Rules must be arrays.
QFU.InvalidIdentifier: Group identifiers must be non-empty and unique.
QFU.InvalidRule: Each rule needs a name and a regex string (which may be blank).
QFU.InvalidLimit: Maximum file size must be a non-negative number; 0 means unlimited.
QFU.InvalidDefault: A rule's Default flag must be true or false.
QFU.MultipleDefaults: {group}: choose at most one default rule.
QFU.InvalidJson: The selected file does not contain valid JSON.
QFU.InvalidExport: This export belongs to another module or an unsupported settings version.
QFU.UnconfirmedUpload: The server did not confirm the upload.
QFU.DataSourceOnly: Choose a folder in the user-data source.
QFU.Allgroups: All groups selected when opening the upload window
QFU.ClipboardHint: Import images or HTML/text from the clipboard. You can also focus this pad and press Ctrl+V.
QFU.ClipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access failed. Click the drop pad text and press Ctrl+V, or allow clipboard access in your browser.
QFU.InvalidClipboard: Check the clipboard image format, naming tokens and default routing option.
QFU.ClipboardConversionFailed: The clipboard image could not be decoded or converted to the requested format.
QFU.Cliponly: Only match clipboard imports (blank regex matches any)
QFU.ClipboardSettingsHint: Explicit clipboard rules run first. Blank clipboard-rule paths inherit this folder. Prefer clipboard defaults skips ordinary file rules. Names are generated after routing; patterns and limits test the source file. Images are really converted before upload. The Clipboard Import rule action uses these defaults before uploading a local file.
QFU.Clipoverride: Prefer clipboard defaults over ordinary file rules
QFU.NameBuilderHint: Drag available tokens into the filename, then drag to reorder. Double-click to define a token. Plus adds a definition; trash removes it. Arrow and add buttons also work without dragging. Preview uses sample content for the hash; the extension is added at import.
QFU.TokenValueHint: Date: YYYY, YY, MM, MMM, DD, HH, mm, ss or combinations like YYYY-MM-DD. Random: 1–32 digits. Separator: any filename-safe text. Other types need no value.
QFU.ManualBatchHint: The shared base receives the clipboard naming extensions for each file. With separate naming, confirm this base to continue to each file.
QFU.BrowserReadFailed: The selected file could not be read.
